item.title: Hezbollah’s unjammable drones pose new threat to Israel
item.description: The cheap weapons have helped the militants rearm despite the loss of a sponsor in Syria and the U.S.-Israeli war on Iran.

item.title: Hegseth, Caine encounter intense bipartisan frustration with Iran war
item.description: As a ceasefire with Tehran falters, Republicans joined Democrats in pressing for details on the conflict’s costs and the administration’s plan to end it.
